to.headline: Hudson Bay drops plans for dedicated private credit platform as BlackRock hires depart
to.summary: Hudson Bay has dropped plans for a dedicated private credit business after Raj Vig and Tim Morris, two senior executives recruited from BlackRock, left, according to a Bloomberg report citing unnamed sources. Hudson Bay had committed about $1bn in seed capital to Vig's team to invest in private credit and raise outside money for a standalone platform. Executives told the remaining team the firm still plans to invest across credit, including private credit. Hudson Bay declined to comment.
